answers.core: Working with Vectors is a huge part of gamedev, and having convenient ways to convert between them is important.
answers.workaround:
It can be, but the whole point is to avoid those few lines and just have one.

Though I understand that this won't be an issue in small codebases or games with not much 2D/3D interopability.
